prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1110; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. Over the course of 25 visits, care consisted of spinal mobilization, soft tissue therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching program instruction. The reported neck injury is consistent in type and severity with the mechanism of the collision as described. Treatment progressed along a typical clinical trajectory, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Examination revealed palpable paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted cervical rotation that support the presence of a soft tissue injury; neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical region is known to this provider. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient was discharged from active care with a home exercise plan and instructions to return if symptoms recur.
